reason: The repository is a standalone DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an A/B workbench to compare multiple coding candidates. Evidence from the README and package manifest shows it orchestrates parallel Builder runs in isolated worktrees, collects deterministic gate/review evidence, supports preview and human verdict recording, and performs explicit two-phase promotion. This indicates a primary purpose of workflow automation/orchestration for model-based coding evaluation with optional repository writes.

summaries.zh: Evidence Arena 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 的独立 A/B 工作台，用于并行运行多个模型编程候选者、展示差异与评审证据，并在用户确认后将选定结果写回当前工作区。
summaries.en: Evidence Arena is a standalone DeepSeek Harness workbench that runs multiple model coding contenders in parallel, shows candidate diffs and review evidence, and applies a chosen result back to the workspace after user confirmation.

capabilities: Run multiple independent AI builders in isolated Git worktrees
Execute model routing and provider-backed coding/review tasks
Apply policy-defined deterministic preflight, test, and review gates
Generate per-file unified diffs and artifact evidence for candidates
Run disposable candidate previews with logs and stop controls
Export versioned evidence reports and apply promoted results to workspace
Use external model credentials through host-managed credential references

reasons.code: Two or three independent Builders and independent Reviewers are described as core behavior, implying parallel multi-run AI execution and code modification capability.
The plugin is delivered as a DSH host/client bundle via dsh.bundle/cordis patch and includes many DeepSeek SDK/tool dependencies for runtime and workflow integration.
Workflow includes explicit setup, preflight checks, policy gates, candidate preview execution, and two-phase, human-acknowledged promotion before writing to the original workspace.
Known limitations explicitly state network access and full host read isolation are not guaranteed, and network-based provider usage is part of operation.
